top_news.title: TALON: A Temporally Aware Longitudinal Framework for Radiology Report Generation
top_news.dek: TALON is a new framework for radiology report generation that adaptively integrates variable-length patient history to improve longitudinal analysis.
top_news.brief: Current radiology report generation models often struggle with long-term comparisons, relying on single or limited prior exams. TALON addresses this by modeling the relevance of each prior examination before fusion, allowing for more accurate detection of subtle interval changes in medical imaging.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the TALON framework architecture for longitudinal radiology report generation.

top_news.title: AX – Google’s Open Agentic Orchestrator
top_news.dek: AX is an open-source orchestration framework designed to manage and scale agentic workflows with built-in isolation and resource management.
top_news.brief: AX provides a declarative way to handle agentic workloads, which require state management, network isolation, and tool access. It supports scaling to billions of tasks by running on the Agent Substrate runtime, offering primitives to manage agent lifecycles and prevent runaway costs.

top_news.title: llm-keys-ui 0.1
top_news.dek: The llm-keys-ui plugin provides a secure, local interface for managing and injecting LLM API keys into remote agent environments.
top_news.brief: Designed for developers using remote coding agents, this tool allows users to configure API keys via a local web interface rather than pasting them directly into chat sessions. It supports local network or Tailscale access, enabling secure key management across multiple machines.
top_news.image_alt: Terminal interface showing the llm-keys-ui command execution.

primary.title: Daily AI usage in the U.S. has more than doubled in just six months
primary.summary: Surveys by Epoch AI and Ipsos suggest AI is becoming part of everyday life for more Americans. The share of US adults using AI almost daily more than doubled between March and August 2026, rising from 8 percent to 19 percent. Meanwhile, the share using it just once a week fell from 17 percent to 10 percent. The article Daily AI usage in the U.S. has more than doubled in just six months appeared first on The Decoder.

primary.title: Following OpenAI, Anthropic is also reportedly postponing its IPO
primary.summary: Anthropic is reportedly delaying its IPO from October to November 2026 to present strong Q3 results. Investors expect a roughly $2 trillion valuation, but rising infrastructure costs, including $1.25 billion a month for its SpaceX deal alone, and unresolved security risks complicate the listing. The article Following OpenAI, Anthropic is also reportedly postponing its IPO appeared first on The Decoder.
